purpose: AI handoff contract for case-level Aegis-ON security-monitoring labels and split governance.
record_granularity: One line per case_id in each manifest. Events from one case_id must never be divided across train, validation, or test.
admission_rules: A case is admissible to supervised training only when eligible_for_training is yes, label_status is not pending_security_review, and its evidence_paths are present.
Synthetic cases must use split synthetic_demo and must not enter production validation, test, incident statistics, or performance reporting.
A label confirmed_security_incident requires a synthetic display label when synthetic is true and must never be reported as an actual incident.
No actual case in this package is currently admitted to train, validation, or test; split_status is insufficient_for_supervised_model_evaluation.
Rows with eligible_for_training no or synthetic_only are excluded from production-validation and test splits.
leakage_prevention: Use case_id as the indivisible leakage key.
Do not split events from one case_id across train, validation, or test.
Do not mix synthetic_demo rows with actual-observed supervised evaluation.
Do not use evidence from one case_group to claim independent generalization.
label_quality_limits: The package contains no actual confirmed-security-incident ground truth.
Actual cases are controlled, limited lifecycle or dependency observations and require security-team review before supervised use.
Synthetic fixtures support parser, correlation, dashboard, and demonstration validation only.
ideathon_demo_allowed_claims: The package demonstrates schema normalization, case-level label governance, synthetic/actual separation, correlation inputs, and alert-priority presentation.
The package is insufficient for supervised model evaluation and does not claim production detection performance.
ideathon_demo_prohibited_claims: Real compromise confirmation from synthetic fixtures
Generalization beyond the listed controlled cases
